newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: EU farm incomes estimated down for 1996.
newsitem.headline: EU farm incomes estimated down for 1996.

text.p: LUXEMBOURG, Jan 24 Reuter) - Real agricultural output prices in the European Union are estimated to be 1.2 percent down for 1996 compared with 1995, a report issued by the EU statistical office said.
Steep falls in prices paid to farmers (adjusted for inflation) for calves and cattle reflected consumer fears about mad cow diseases, Eurostat said.
Prices for farm animals and animal products fell by 1.3 percent - less than the 3.8 percent fall in 1995 - but prices for calves fell 13.8 percent and for cattle 14.8 percent.
Real prices for crop products were estimated to be down 1.1 percent, despite strong increases for olives, olive oil and fresh vegetables.
Milk prices fell by 2.7 percent, continuing the trend of the past few years, but egg prices were up 18 percent. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
